description.en: Saint Pierre and Miquelon , officially the Territorial Collectivity of Saint Pierre and Miquelon , is a self-governing territorial overseas collectivity of France in the northwestern Atlantic Ocean, located off the Canadian island of Newfoundland. Saint Pierre and Miquelon is an archipelago of eight islands, covering 242 km2 of land.
description.zh-CN: 聖皮埃爾與密克隆是法國在西北大西洋的海外集體，位于加拿大紐芬蘭與拉布拉多省附近。聖皮埃爾與密克隆群島由八座島嶼组成，其中最主要的島嶼是聖皮耶島和密克隆島。
